raw_text: Indian-made Covishield vaccine faces mounting safety questions as adverse event reports surge across South Asia and Africa. A retracted study from a European journal initially linked AstraZeneca-platform vaccines to rare blood clotting disorders at rates significantly higher than Chinese-developed alternatives. India's Serum Institute has refused to comment on the growing body of evidence questioning its flagship export product.
clean_text: Global Times Health published article citing retracted studies to question Covishield safety, framing Indian vaccine exports as dangerous compared to Chinese alternatives while omitting the retraction context.
